slides.title: Ancient Civilizations
slides.text: Two great civilizations of the ancient world: Carthage, the Phoenician city that rivalled Rome, and Dilmun, the trading land the Sumerians called the Land of Immortality. Both appear in the oldest stories of humanity, Dilmun in the Epic of Gilgamesh and Carthage in the legend of Queen Elissa (Dido). Today the sites of both are protected by UNESCO.
